cues: Back to the wall, sit into the stance and slide along the wall, low and level.
Push the floor away from the way you want to go.
Stay low and level, like under a low ceiling.

faults.fault: Crossing the feet in the slide
faults.fix: Push the floor away and step toward the cone first, never crossing.
Stay low and level, like under a low ceiling.

name: Transition Defense Get-Back Sprint
setup: Cones set for the drill; athletic stance, feet wider than the hips.
cues: On the call, sprint back past half court, turn and find the ball in a stance.
Push the floor away from the way you want to go.
Stay low and level, like under a low ceiling.

faults.fault: Crossing the feet in the slide
faults.fix: Push the floor away and step toward the cone first, never crossing.
Stay low and level, like under a low ceiling.
